messages:
eric: Quick sync 1: customer wants BYOK import, escrowless, plus explicit RBAC windows and signed audit bundles. Need short Qs for SOW. cc @mia @hailey

mia: JIT-only for imports by default. STS token with tags (ticket_id, approver_ids) + MFA. TTL 2h. Persistent accounts only for downstream admin tasks.

hailey: Audit bundle: gzipped JSONL, per-event metadata, merkle root + RFC3161 timestamp, signer cert chain. Store in Object Lock (governance) and optionally mirror to customer S3.

eric: Legal asks for incident bullet flow if an operator key is suspected compromised.

mia: Short IR: 1) auto-revoke operator entitlements (<=2m), 2) snapshot & sign forensic bundle (<=6h), 3) block further imports for affected HSM model if CVE, 4) rewrap KEK we manage, 5) notify customer and provide signed evidence.

hailey: Pre-import checks: require headers X-HSM-SERIAL and X-HSM-FW-SHA256; proxy verifies against onboarding allowlist. If firmware on denylist (e.g., CVE-2027-1234) -> block and open P0.

sec-bot: advisory: vendor-hsm-cve-2027-1234 detected for models "Raptor-1" "Raptor-2". See infra advisory link.

eric: Dual-op imports? Our proxy is single-operator today. Options: (a) customer-provided threshold HSM, (b) manual dual-op with video witness + signed attestations. Include both in SOW.

mia: Also add signed-manifest (sha256) and separate CMK encryption for stored bundles. Customer wants 3yr immutability 1: Object Lock + cold archive is fine but flag cost.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: added pre-import allowlist check to staging proxy and CloudTrail->export pipeline. CI: deploy-2025-04-11-09 :white_check_mark:

eric: Action items: Mia -> draft JIT RBAC + approval template; Hailey -> signed bundle spec with merkle+RFC3161 + cost stub; I'll add SOW Qs and loop Legal. Shareable with Sales?

mia: Shareable.

hailey: SGTM, thanks :thumbsup:
